overall.one_line_summary: The repaired preflight layer now fails closed on stale authority, symmetric worktree overlap, unsafe stores, and same-volume capacity while preserving zero measured counters.
strengths: Passed receipts are revalidated against current D1/D2/D3 and lifecycle counter authority before projection.
Store paths are rejected when they are inside a worktree or contain one, and symlink, junction, sentinel, overlap, and directory checks are covered.
Aggregate free space is counted once per filesystem or volume and cannot exceed the per-store evidence retained in the receipt.
The CLI exposes not_started, failed, and passed_pending_owner without emitting absolute Owner-local paths.
The candidate proposal remains draft_owner_review and not_adopted with exactly four controls, eight preregistered candidates, and five explicit Owner approval items.
weaknesses: The preflight receipt is point-in-time engineering evidence and must be rerun before a future measured request if the environment changes.
No measured P2 result, real candidate registration, shortlist, selection exposure, or final-split evidence exists.

strengths: Focused tests directly exercise every named preflight and proposal invariant.
Each failure maps to an exact check ID and failure-code set, and stale passes become invalid.
weaknesses: Filesystem capacity remains a point-in-time observation.
suggestions: Rerun preflight immediately before any separately authorized measured request.

strengths: The repair stays repository-safe, CPU-only, unmeasured, and final-split closed.
Receipt, live authority, read model, report state, and candidate proposal now form a fail-closed chain.
weaknesses: Owner approval of the proposed scientific definitions remains intentionally pending.
suggestions: Do not adopt or hash-lock candidates until the listed ambiguities are resolved.

strengths: The initial Weak Reject review is preserved and linked as the observed failure that motivated repair.
weaknesses: This package contains engineering validation only, not retrieval exploration.

strengths: Focused and full synthetic suites passed, with negative coverage for path, store, binding, gate, counter, receipt, and CLI states.
weaknesses: Actual Owner-local stores and protected payloads were intentionally not accessed.
suggestions: Keep the next action limited to Owner-local measured preflight.

findings.observation: A passed receipt is revalidated against mutable repository authority but cannot re-open path identities because absolute Owner-local paths are deliberately absent.
findings.reasoning: Environmental capacity and store identity remain time-sensitive even though the repository projection is fail-closed for gate and counter changes.
findings.suggestion: Rerun the Owner-local preflight immediately before a separately authorized measured request and do not treat an older pass as perpetual authorization.

Confirm the fixed DAPFAM train/selection protocol and CPU-only zero-cost boundary.
Request creation of a separate measured request only after proposal acceptance; D2 and D3 remain closed.
